## 2. Peer-Reviewed Research Publication
### Integrating Computer Vision and Large Language Models for Real-Time Blind Navigation
- **Journal:** Cureus Journal of Computer Science (Springer Nature)
- **Year:** 2026
- **DOI:** https://doi.org/10.7759/s44389-026-00265-x
- **Hardware & Stack:** Raspberry Pi edge compute, Python, OpenCV, Multimodal LLM reasoning, Voice-Vision pipeline
- **Architecture & Empirical Results:**
  - Designed a hands-free, wearable assistive system that captures live camera streams on a Raspberry Pi, identifies obstacles using edge computer vision, and translates spatial hazards into natural voice guidance.
  - **Wake-Word Latency:** 0.6 seconds
  - **Speech Recognition Accuracy:** 93% in controlled environments
  - **Real-Time Obstacle Detection Accuracy:** 88% across empirical user trials

## 4. Technical Architecture of Key Projects

### 4.1 Neo-Analytics (Data Engineering)
- **Repository:** https://github.com/dhiraj-rajput/neo-project
- **Stack:** NASA NeoWs API, Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, TimescaleDB, Grafana
- **Architecture:**
  - Streams live NASA near-Earth asteroid telemetry through Apache Kafka topics and Apache Spark streaming jobs.
  - Stores partitioned time-series records in TimescaleDB hypertables for sub-second analytical queries.
  - Visualizes orbital proximity, velocity, and hazard thresholds on real-time Grafana dashboards.

### 4.2 RakshaNetra - Proactive Data Leakage Prevention for LLMs (Edge AI & Privacy)
- **Repository:** https://github.com/dhiraj-rajput/rakshak-pii
- **Stack:** Python, FastAPI, Regex Pattern Engine, Token Redaction, Zero-Trust Edge Proxy
- **Architecture:**
  - Intercepts outbound prompts at the client edge before they reach external LLM providers.
  - Redacts API keys, credentials, and personally identifiable information (PII) in sub-millisecond latency.
  - Maintains local audit logs for enterprise compliance verification without exposing raw secrets.

### 4.3 BidForge - Automated RFP Multi-Agent Response Pipeline (SaaS & Automation)
- **Repository:** https://github.com/dhiraj-rajput/BidForge
- **Stack:** Python, FastAPI, Multi-Agent LLMs, LangChain, AWS S3
- **Architecture:**
  - Decomposes multi-page enterprise RFP PDFs into structured compliance checklists.
  - Orchestrates asynchronous FastAPI workers for requirement classification and section drafting.
  - Persists proposal documents in AWS S3 with role-scoped access policies.

### 4.4 RIFT - Remote Intrusion Framework (Cybersecurity)
- **Repository:** https://github.com/dhiraj-rajput/rift-agent
- **Stack:** Go, Django REST, React, Celery, Redis, MySQL
- **Architecture:**
  - Coordinates simulated intrusion exercises using lightweight Go agents and a React operations dashboard.
  - Dispatches asynchronous scan and enumeration tasks via Celery workers backed by Redis queues.
  - Implements authenticated, idempotent REST endpoints with structured audit logging and retry circuits.

### 4.5 Omniscient (Full-Stack & AI)
- **Repository:** https://github.com/dhiraj-rajput/Omniscient
- **Stack:** Django, React, Local LLaMA, WebSockets, MongoDB, Node.js
- **Architecture:**
  - Provides team task management with strict role-based access control (RBAC) and JWT-authenticated WebSockets.
  - Automates ticket triage and thread summaries using locally hosted LLaMA models.
  - Reduced backend query latency by 40% using compound MongoDB indexes.
